title: Pupa app metadata.json
description: Per-app metadata contributors hand-write. See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/spec.md. Enforced by scripts/validate.py.

id.description: App slug; must equal the apps/<slug>/ directory name.

version.description: Catalog entry version; bump on every change to app.pupa.

license.description: Content license for this app (SPDX id or short name). Omit for the repo default (CC0-1.0, see CONTENT-LICENSE). Set only if you hold the rights to release under it.

attribution.description: Required credit line + link when the license demands attribution (e.g. CC BY / BY-NC-SA).
